'''Trammel's island''' was a floating island on [[Dorumaa]] that was used by [[Rufus Trammel]] as his base of operations on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]]. It was made up of many different [[Skiff/Legends|skiffs]] and ships that had all been hooked together, although they were all still functional, so the island could be dispersed at a moments notice. It floated abput 10 meters above the sea and was fitted with extensive security systems. He also had some of his poachers carry out regular security patrols on it. Trammel once sent out some of his men from the island to transport the [[Dorumaan leviathan]] [[Jessel]] and his meeting was secretly watched by the [[Heroes of Cularin]]. Afterward, the heroes rescued the [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[A. Rahring]] from the island.
